scientific_integrity: The all-exponent conclusion is supported by an explicit integer proof; finite checks cover exponents one through eight and are not an infinite certificate. No authorship or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact normal form and embedding dimension only for the natural ideal powers of the numerical semigroup generated additively by 3,4,5; no claim for arbitrary numerical semigroups or their other invariants.
title: Linear minimal-generator growth for multiplicative powers of the numerical semigroup \(\langle3,4,5\rangle\)
